html:
A soldier and close friend of Thomas Sankara who took power in the coup of 15 October 1987 in which Sankara was killed, and ruled Burkina Faso until 2014.

He reversed much of Sankara's revolution, made peace with France and the IMF, and won elections from 1991. He became a regional power broker, mediating in Ivory Coast, Togo and Mali, but was also accused of helping Charles Taylor and the rebels of Sierra Leone. His attempt to change the constitution to run again set off the 2014 uprising, and he fled to Ivory Coast. In 2022 a Burkinabe court sentenced him in absence to life in prison for Sankara's murder.
